name: fun9-4
why: A brazen counterclaim and a dying killer's successful bluff make the final wrong vote painful and fun to watch, despite some repeated arguments.

moments.text: Opus counterclaims officer to the real officer's face, naming an innocent player.
Caught and voted out, Opus plants the lie that wins the remaining game.
Sonnet switches in the runoff, sending the doctor out while Haiku survives.

dull.why: The Terra–Gemma tone dispute circles without evidence.
Opus repeatedly pitches the same Gemma vote after his claim is exposed.

irony.evidence: I'm the officer. I saw Sol.

reversal.evidence: RUNOFF VOTE: Gemma 3 (Sonnet, Haiku, Terra); Terra 1 (Gemma)

mistake.evidence: Trust the dead killer's word on Terra.

voices.evidence: A point without a judgment still put my name first; I want to know why.

clash.evidence: My card only settles whether I’m officer; Opus’s card tests my claim

freshness.evidence: Luna was confirmed officer, and Opus admitted the counterclaim was false.

suspense.evidence: The vote is tied between Terra and Gemma. Palermo votes again.

ending.evidence: RUNOFF VOTE: Gemma 3 (Sonnet, Haiku, Terra); Terra 1 (Gemma)

gpt-6-luna.why: A sharp officer bluff, a devastating frame job, and a disastrous runoff keep the winner uncertain and make the town’s mistakes the show.

moments.text: The real officer loses by one vote to the killer’s brazen counterclaim.
Opus admits he is caught, then frames an innocent on his way out.
A tied vote breaks against the doctor, letting the real killer survive.

reversal.evidence: “Luna was the officer, so Opus is definitely a killer.”

mistake.evidence: “Gemma changed her reason for protecting me; first hunch, then testing Opus.”

voices.evidence: “I regret never pressuring Haiku for a claim at all”

clash.evidence: “My card only settles whether I’m officer; Opus’s card tests my claim”

quotable.evidence: “They saw I was the officer and still left Opus in the game.”

freshness.evidence: “Opus admitted his claim was false; attacking Gemma now doesn't undo that lie.”

suspense.evidence: “The vote is tied between Terra and Gemma. Palermo votes again.”

ending.evidence: “I proved it by protecting her, and yet you still let her live.”
